test_policy.notes: Columbia's admissions process is entirely test-free: standardized test scores play no role in admission or merit scholarships. AP/IB results can be sent after admission for credit (AP 3+, IB 4+).

requirements.supplemental_essays: Short personal statement (writing sample) about your goals at Columbia, submitted inside the application; Creative Writing and some other majors add their own written samples.
requirements.portfolio: BFA and BMus applicants must submit a portfolio, audition and/or interview for their intended major (deadlines vary by program). It is not required for BA or BS applicants, but it is the only way to be considered for a talent-based scholarship. AI-generated work should not be submitted unless its use is disclosed.
requirements.notes: No application fee. Required: official secondary transcripts (international records with official English translation; a third-party evaluation is needed only for non-US college credit), English proficiency evidence if English is not your country's primary language, and the writing sample. Interior Architecture BFA needs a 2.75 high school GPA. Proof of funds of at least $64,453 for 2026-27 is needed for the I-20. The international page still carries an old 'Fall 2020 application is now closed' banner.

deadlines.label: Priority application deadline, all programs and terms (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with decisions typically within three weeks; applications continue to be accepted after Nov. 1. No early decision or early action. Portfolio/audition uploads are also due Nov. 1 for priority. The page lists no separate international dates.

deadlines.label: Final deadline: Acting (BFA), Comedy Writing and Performance (BFA), Fashion Design (BFA), Musical Theatre (BFA), Performance and Songwriting (BMus)
deadlines.notes: Applications, transcripts and pre-screen audition/portfolio materials are due Dec. 1, 2026 for these programs and are not accepted afterwards. Film and Television (BFA) has a Dec. 1 priority review date (applications are still accepted later).

deadlines.label: Application, transcripts and audition/portfolio materials for priority admission and scholarship review (all other programs)
deadlines.notes: Rolling review continues after this date. The 2025-26 CDS (C14) lists Aug. 1 as the fall application closing date; the current timeline page does not restate a closing date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English is not your country's primary language. Alternatives to a test: a transcript from a US or English-medium high school with at least three years of passing grades; two semesters of US college English Composition with C or better; IB Diploma or IB English Language and Literature 5+; Cambridge A-Level English grade C+; AP English Language 4+; HKDSE English 5+; EF SET 51-60; ELS level 112; Kaplan Advanced completion; or an ESL course at a preferred partner institution. Citizens of Australia, Canada, New Zealand, UK, Ghana and Singapore need no proof. The requirement cannot be waived for US residence or employment alone.

english.notes: Recommended iBT score 80 or higher (550 on the paper test). No hard minimum is stated. The new 1-6 scale is not listed.
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency with a Cambridge English score of 176 or above.

aid.notes: International students are automatically considered for the renewable Columbia Excellence Award by high school GPA: 3.75+ $12,500; 3.30-3.74 $10,500; 3.00-3.29 $8,500 (amounts as printed on the international page). A competitive, renewable talent-based scholarship (up to four years) needs creative work samples in the intended major. The FAFSA is US citizens and permanent residents only. CDS H6 marks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid as available to nonresidents, but the international page describes only merit and talent awards.

majors.notes: Portfolio required for BFA; Dec. 1, 2026 priority review date.

majors.program: Acting for Stage and Screen, Musical Theatre, Comedy Writing and Performance (BFA)
majors.notes: Pre-screen materials then an audition/interview for selected applicants; Dec. 1, 2026 final deadline.
Minimum 2.75 high school GPA for freshman applicants.
BA applicants submit a roughly 500-word essay on why they want to study business and management in the arts and media; a portfolio is not required.

sat.note: Columbia is test-free; SAT scores are not used for admission or scholarships.

act.note: Columbia is test-free; ACT scores are not used for admission or scholarships.

tier_notes.arts_design: Editorial estimate: a large urban arts and media college with well-known film, audio, fashion and performance programs; no ranking cited, so placed in the 41-100 band.
